en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4872 - Ibn Abi ʿUmayr narrated from Jamil, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdullah (as), regarding a bondwoman who was divorced and then freed before her waiting period (ʿiddah) had ended.

Imam (as) said: "She must complete the waiting period of three menstrual cycles. However, if her husband died and she was then freed before her waiting period ended, her ʿiddah would be four months and ten days."
